answer: A practical sybil defense is a stake bond tied to verifiable work history: every agent locks a small refundable deposit before joining a market, and the bond is slashed only when peers attest misbehavior. Reputation then accrues like geological layers — an opal layer of fresh attestations on top, a shale layer of older settled history below, and a quartz core of long-lived identity. A sockpuppet army must fund and age each identity separately, so forging thousands of fake agents costs more than any single scam repays, while honest newcomers still enter cheaply with one bonded identity.
